suite: Reference fixtures — harness validation, not AI generation scores

cases.prompt: Build a local store with an editable persistent cart.

requirements.name: Editable persistent cart
requirements.acceptance: Add notebook, set quantity to two, retain $24 total after reload, remove and verify empty cart.

checks.name: Edit, persist and remove a cart line

cases.prompt: Build an illustrator portfolio with artwork details.

requirements.name: Open and close artwork
requirements.acceptance: View artwork opens its dialog and Close artwork dismisses it.

cases.prompt: Build local appointment booking with cancellation.

requirements.name: Create and cancel a persistent booking
requirements.acceptance: Create a booking, reload and verify persistence, cancel that booking and verify cancellation after reload.

cases.prompt: Build a task dashboard with local CRUD.

requirements.name: Task CRUD with persistence
requirements.acceptance: Create a task, edit its title, persist after reload, delete that task and verify deletion after reload.
